products.title: XCEED™ 763376_CS, Nitrile Exam Glove, Small, Standard Cuff Length, Blue, Not Rated
products.body_html:
XCEED™ 763376_CS , Nitrile Exam Glove, Small, NonSterile, Standard Cuff Length, Textured Fingertips, Blue, Not Rated (250/BX 10BX/CS)

The XCEED nitrile exam gloves are designed to offer soft and comfortable wear, making them an excellent choice for medical professionals seeking enhanced tactile sensitivity. These gloves help reduce hand fatigue during prolonged use, ensuring efficiency and comfort throughout the day.

These gloves are crafted from high-quality nitrile material, offering a fingertip thickness of 0.09 mm (3.5 mil) and a length of 9.3 inches, providing excellent durability and protection. Although these gloves are not chemo rated, they are ideal for various medical and non-surgical procedures. The blue color and textured exterior enhance visibility and grip, making them reliable for single-use applications.

Features

  • Soft and comfortable design for improved tactile sensitivity
  • Ambidextrous fit with textured fingertips for a secure grip
  • Beaded cuffs to prevent roll-down and provide additional strength
  • Powder-free and latex-free, making them suitable for individuals with latex allergies
  • Available in XL size for a perfect fit
  • 250 gloves per box, ensuring ample supply

products.title: Poltex CHEMO2 Chemo Glove Box Holder
products.body_html:
Poltex CHEMO2 Durable PETG Wall-Mount Holder for Covidien Kendall Chemo Plus Gloves – Secure Storage with Flexible Mounting Options

Poltex’s CHEMO2 Chemo Glove Box Holder is a robust, specialized organizer designed to securely hold and dispense one box of Covidien Kendall Chemo Plus gloves (hand-specific chemotherapy gloves) in oncology, pharmacy compounding, hazardous drug handling, or clinical environments. Constructed from super-durable 1/4" thick PETG with polished edges, this holder resists chemicals, alcohol, and frequent disinfection while providing a clean, professional appearance. The open-front design allows easy access and quick restocking while keeping gloves protected from dust and contamination. Choose from wall mount (screws and anchors included), powerful magnet mount (for metal surfaces), or VHB tape mount (very high bond tape for permanent adhesion). Consumables (glove box) shown for demonstration only – not included. See product image for exact dimensions. Made in USA for reliable, hygienic performance that supports safe handling of chemotherapy drugs.

Features:

  • Specifically fits Covidien Kendall Chemo Plus hand-specific chemotherapy glove boxes
  • Super-durable 1/4" thick PETG construction – chemical-resistant and easy to clean/disinfect
  • Open-front access for quick, single-handed glove retrieval and simple restocking
  • Flexible mounting: Wall (screws/anchors), Magnet (for metal), or VHB tape
  • Polished edges for a clean, professional look in oncology or compounding pharmacies

  • Consumables Not Included: Covidien Kendall Chemo Plus glove boxes sold separately.
  • Installation Tips: VHB tape requires clean, non-porous surface; magnets for ferrous metal; wall mount uses included screws/anchors for drywall or wood.
  • Cleaning: Wipe with alcohol or disinfectant; PETG resists chemicals and scratches.
  • Permissible Ambient: 5-40°C; suitable for oncology pharmacies, compounding areas, or hazardous drug handling zones.
  • Applications: Secure storage and dispensing of chemotherapy gloves in oncology, pharmacy, or clinical settings. Volume discounts available – call or email for orders of 10+ units.
